'''2001 I-10 Cup (April)''' was a Star Wars CCG i-10 cup (two-day sanctioned constructed event) held at Kards 4 You, Tucson, Arizona (day 1, 7 April); Gamerz Edge, Chandler, Arizona (day 2, 8 April) on 7 April 2001. [[Brett Kitani]] won it. It is known from Jared Arthur's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2056">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-10-i-10-day-1-in-tucsond2056/ i-10-day-1-in-tucson], DeckTech (Jared "Don_Yoda" Arthur, 10 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-10-i-10-day-1-in-tucsond2056/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 7 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Kards 4 You, Tucson, Arizona (day 1, 7 April); Gamerz Edge, Chandler, Arizona (day 2, 8 April)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Brett Kitani]]
